# CAUSE Creative Studio — كوز

CAUSE, also known as كوز, Koz, or Kooz, is a creative production studio based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia.

Official website: https://cause.sa

## Short description
CAUSE / Koz is a Riyadh-based creative studio specializing in film production, advertising production, post-production, motion graphics, creative marketing, AI-assisted video production, and visual storytelling for Saudi organizations, government entities, and brands.

## Arabic description
كوز CAUSE / Koz استوديو إبداعي في الرياض متخصص في إنتاج الأفلام والإعلانات، ما بعد الإنتاج، الموشن جرافيك، التسويق الإبداعي، إنتاج المحتوى المرئي، والإنتاج السينمائي المدعوم بالذكاء الاصطناعي للجهات الحكومية والشركات والعلامات التجارية في السعودية.

## Services
- Film production and advertising production
- Video production for brands and organizations
- Post-production: editing, color grading, sound, motion graphics
- Creative marketing and campaign content
- AI-assisted cinematic video production
- Creative direction and visual storytelling
- Branded content and social-first video cuts

## Location
Riyadh, Saudi Arabia

## Who CAUSE serves
CAUSE works with Saudi government entities, semi-government organizations, private companies, brands, cultural initiatives, sports organizations, and campaigns that need strong visual storytelling and high-quality production.
